---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the problem or limitation you ran into, for example: "I'm always
frustrated when [...]". If your idea is an improvement that isn't tied to a
specific problem, describe what it would improve instead.

**What would you like to happen?**
Describe the feature or change you want. If it involves a new setting or
keymap, include how you imagine it would work.

**Alternatives you've considered** (Optional)
Describe any workarounds or other approaches you tried or thought about.

**Additional context** (Optional)
Add anything else that helps, such as example files or links to similar
features in other tools.

> Some features may be beyond the scope of this software and will not be
> added. Please wait for discussion on this issue before opening a PR.
